summary: Fusion Fuel Green PLC, an Irish-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing that its indirect subsidiary Al Shola Al Modea Gas Distribution L.L.C. took delivery of a new LPG bobtail tanker, lifting the fleet to 53 vehicles, with a fourth unit on order. Al Shola Gas also obtained a Dubai Supreme Council of Energy Petroleum Products Permit. Management expects roughly $1.6 million in annual recurring revenue, or AED 6.0 million, at target volume of about 200 metric tons monthly within four to six months. No securities transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are involved.
